input.summary: Ported saxpy.cu to SYCL 2020 in saxpy_sycl.cpp. It has no dpct:: helpers, no DPCT_* macros and no <dpct/...> includes. It uses a sycl::queue with enable_profiling, malloc_shared/free USM, a 1-D nd_range (local 256, global rounded up to a multiple of 256) with an in-kernel bounds check, and event profiling timing. It compiles with icpx -fsycl and add_dpct_include=false (build/candidate, 0 warnings). Correctness: running the candidate with n=1048576 and comparing against a host C++ reference of a*x+y gives max abs diff 4.77e-7, within atol 1e-6 (PASS).
